cq: Which merchants have the highest number of fraud-flagged transactions?
What merchant categories are most associated with fraud?
Which transactions occurred where the cardholder's location and merchant location are more than 50km apart?
sparql:
PREFIX eli: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/ontology#>
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX geo1: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
PREFIX lkg: <http://example.org/lkg#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

ASK {
  ?transaction a ex:CreditCardTransaction ;
               ex:atMerchant ?merchant .
  ?merchant geo1:lat ?merchantLat ;
           geo1:long ?merchantLong .
  ?cardholder schema:address ?address .
  ?address geo1:lat ?cardholderLat ;
           geo1:long ?cardholderLong .
  
  BIND(6371 * acos(cos(radians(?cardholderLat)) * cos(radians(?merchantLat)) * cos(radians(?merchantLong) - radians(?cardholderLong)) + sin(radians(?cardholderLat)) * sin(radians(?merchantLat))) AS ?distance)
  
  FILTER(?distance > 50)
}

cq: How many transactions occurred within the same hour across all cardholders?
sparql:
PREFIX eli: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/ontology#>
PREFIX geo1: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
PREFIX lkg: <http://example.org/lkg#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>

ASK {
  ?transaction1 a ex:CreditCardTransaction ;
                ex:unixTime ?time1 .
  ?transaction2 a ex:CreditCardTransaction ;
                ex:unixTime ?time2 .
  FILTER(?transaction1 != ?transaction2)
  FILTER(floor(?time1 / 3600) = floor(?time2 / 3600))
}

cq: Which cardholder made multiple transactions within a 10-minute window?
sparql:
PREFIX eli: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/ontology#>
PREFIX geo1: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
PREFIX lkg: <http://example.org/lkg#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>

ASK {
  ?cardholder a schema:Person ;
              schema:makesTransaction ?transaction1 .
  ?transaction1 a ex:CreditCardTransaction ;
                 ex:unixTime ?time1 .
  ?cardholder schema:makesTransaction ?transaction2 .
  ?transaction2 a ex:CreditCardTransaction ;
                 ex:unixTime ?time2 .
  FILTER(?transaction1 != ?transaction2)
  FILTER(?time2 - ?time1 <= 600)  # 10 minutes in seconds
}
